mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `employee_interview` (interview_uuid, employee_uuid, interview_type, interview_time, content, handler_user_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{interviewUuid}, #{employeeUuid}, #{interviewType}, #{interviewTime}, #{content}, #{handlerUserId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT i.interview_uuid, i.id, i.employee_uuid, i.interview_type, i.interview_time, i.content, i.handler_user_id, i.created_by, i.created_at, i.updated_at, u.username AS handler_name FROM `employee_interview` i LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = i.handler_user_id WHERE i.interview_uuid = #{interviewUuid} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.interview_uuid, i.id, i.employee_uuid, i.interview_type, i.interview_time, i.content, i.handler_user_id, i.created_by, i.created_at, i.updated_at, u.username AS handler_name FROM `employee_interview` i LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = i.handler_user_id WHERE i.employee_uuid = #{employeeUuid} ORDER BY i.interview_time DESC, i.id DESC
